variants.when_en: Group questions when they span multiple topics

use.t: 问题较多、答案需要按需展开时，可使用 {c:collapse}
问题应来自真实搜索、客服或访谈记录
答案第一句给结论，细节往后放
答案末尾放下一步 {c:link}：指向文档或 {c:cta}

dont.t: 把 FAQ 写成自问自答的软文：「为什么我们这么优秀？」
答案过长却没有先给结论，应分段突出结果、条件和下一步
问题很多时全部展开会增加浏览成本，应考虑收起、分组或搜索
把价格等影响决策的关键信息只放在 FAQ，会增加查找成本

lessonPractice.title: 客服记录显示用户反复询问退款期限和数据安全。官网 FAQ 应该怎样整理这些内容？

options.label: 按真实问题写标题，答案先给结论，再说明条件和下一步入口
options.feedback: 真实问题对应实际疑虑，先给结论能快速解答，条件和链接帮助用户继续处理。

options.label: 改写成“为什么我们是最佳选择”等问题，用答案集中介绍优点
options.feedback: 自问自答的宣传没有解决客服反复收到的具体疑问，会降低 FAQ 的可信度。

options.label: 只在 FAQ 答案深处说明退款限制，购买区域不再重复展示
options.feedback: FAQ 可以补充细节，但影响购买决定的限制不能只等待用户主动展开寻找。

en.title: Support records show repeated questions about refund windows and data security. How should the site FAQ organize them?

options.label: Use the real questions as headings, answer with the conclusion first, then conditions and a next-step link
options.feedback: Real questions address actual concerns, a conclusion answers quickly, and conditions plus links support follow-up.

options.label: Rewrite them as Why are we the best choice? and use the answers to list product strengths
options.feedback: Promotional self-questioning does not resolve the concrete issues repeatedly reaching support and weakens trust.

options.label: Put refund limits only deep inside FAQ answers and remove them from the purchase area
options.feedback: FAQ can add detail, but a condition that affects purchase should not depend on users discovering a hidden answer.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请根据客服记录整理 FAQ，不要编造宣传式问题。每个答案第一句给结论，再写适用条件和文档或操作入口；退款期限等购买关键信息仍需在定价与 CTA 附近可见。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Build the FAQ from support records rather than invented promotional questions. Start every answer with its conclusion, then add conditions and a documentation or action link. Keep purchase-critical details such as refund windows visible near pricing and CTAs.
